source.data_source: Oracle: OpenFOAM v2412 simpleFoam + Spalart-Allmaras, snappyHexMesh background-on-airfoil ~107k cells, no addLayers (y+ ~ 1000+ at suction-side max-Cf with wall functions). alpha=13.87 deg, M~0.09, Re_c=1.52e6, c=1m, U=30 m/s, nu=1.97e-5, 2000 simpleFoam iters.
source.ref_data_source: Coles, D. & Wadcock, A. J. (1979) flying-hot-wire study at alpha=13.87 deg, Re_c=1.52e6. Published RANS span CL ~ 1.62 (SST) to ~ 1.72 (SA). Surface Cp at https://tmbwg.github.io/turbmodels/NACA4412sep_validation/.
source.calibration_note: gt_value comes from the oracle (this repo's solve.sh), not Coles-Wadcock or RANS-consensus. Without addLayers the oracle's wall BL is under-resolved → near-stall lift is under-predicted by ~33% (CL 1.10 vs RANS 1.65), drag is over-predicted ~5x (CD 0.149 vs ~0.030), separation is predicted too far upstream (x/c=0.57 vs 0.825), and Cp recovery on the suction side is muted (Cp@x/c=0.6 is -0.32 vs -0.85). T_good is wide (~25-35% of gt) to accept agent runs on similar coarse snappy meshes; physics_min/max are wide enough that well-resolved RANS (y+<1, addLayers, ~300k+ cells) reproducing Coles-Wadcock still pass the physics gate even though they will fall outside T_bad of this oracle.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the airfoil mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: Oracle's snappyHexMesh L4-L5 + nearbox/wakebox refinement gives ~107k cells. T_good wide because agents may pick L3-L6; physics_min=20k filters out single-block airfoil meshes that won't resolve LE.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the momentum equation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Oracle reaches 4.4e-7 in 2000 iter. Kept loose because near-stall flows often won't fully steady-converge below 1e-3.

cl.T_good_source: Oracle CL=1.101 (vs RANS-consensus 1.65, oracle 33% low — partial-stall on coarse wall). T_good=0.20 (~18%) accommodates similar coarse-mesh runs; physics_max=2.20 covers well-resolved SA RANS that reach 1.72.

cd.T_good_source: Oracle CD=0.149 (vs experimental ~0.030, oracle 5x high — coarse wall + numerical dissipation at LE). physics_min=0.015 admits well-resolved oracles reproducing Coles-Wadcock; physics_max=0.30 catches gross failure.

cp_at_xc_06_upper.description: Wall Cp on the upper surface at x/c=0.6 (linear interpolation between agent's nearest tabulated wall stations)
cp_at_xc_06_upper.T_good_source: Oracle Cp@x/c=0.6 = -0.318 (vs Coles-Wadcock plot ~-0.85, oracle's coarse wall mutes suction recovery). T_good wide because separation flow has large model + grid spread; physics_min=-2.5 admits well-resolved suction peaks.

separation_xc_upper.description: x/c on the upper surface where wall Cf first crosses from positive to negative
separation_xc_upper.T_good_source: Oracle separation x/c = 0.575 (vs Coles-Wadcock 0.825, oracle predicts separation too far upstream because coarse BL detaches early). T_bad=0.32 covers Coles-Wadcock 0.825; physics_min=0.30 filters out gross-failure cases that report LE separation.
